quarterly_data.signal: Company profile (deck): Eternal describes itself as one of the leading suppliers of dry film photoresist in the world and one of the three largest UV curable monomer and oligomer suppliers. 2025 product-line sales ratio: Resins Materials 48.22%, Electronic Materials 25.75% (dry film photoresist, dry film solder mask, UV ink, dry film photosensitive polyimide, liquid polyimide material, vacuum laminator, toll coating service, copper clad laminates), High Performance Materials 25.43%, Others 0.60% (including liquid molding compound); 2025 consolidated revenue US$1,305 million; 24 production sites. Its new-development list includes advanced packaging materials - liquid epoxy molding compound, underfill and silicon photonics packaging adhesive - and photosensitive polyimide (PSPI) among flexible electronics materials.
